verdict.rationale: Mangopay's docs describe a wallet layer built to receive, hold, split and transfer funds, and say platforms can create unlimited wallets that hold funds as long as needed. Payouts to seller bank accounts and webhook notifications make platform-controlled release possible, and chargeback/dispute handling is documented as deducting from the wallet. Missing for 10: explicit docs on scheduled or conditional release, documented limits and constraints on escrow-style holding (e.g. maximum hold periods or regulatory caveats), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
